newsitem.title: USA: Hugoton hires firm to explore options.
newsitem.headline: Hugoton hires firm to explore options.

text.p: Hugoton Energy Corp said Friday it hired Petrie Parkman & Co to assist it in evaluating strategic alternatives, including a sale of the company, merger with another company or remaining independent.
Hugoton also confirmed that it executed a joint confidentiality agreement with Belco Oil & Gas Corp, which has purchased 2,940,000 shares of Hugoton stock.
Earlier, Belco said it purchased the stock for $10.50 a share from affiliates of First Reserve Corp.
Belco said in its statement that there are no assurances a business combination transaction would occur with Hugoton.
